objects.description: [TeamPCP Cloud Stealer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9041) has detected if it is on a developer machine by checking if the environmental variable  GITHUB_ACTIONS != “true”.(Citation: Wiz Trivy Compromise MAR 2026) [TeamPCP Cloud Stealer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9041) has also identified readable memory regions on CI/CD runners and enumerated system information using `hostname` and `uname-a`.(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)
